source_text_or_questionnaire_resource: prohibited; validate against separately supplied trusted packet

basic_extensions.response-canonical-json: valueString: exact serialized JSON of the same permitted response. Python or browser serialization is accepted; parse and semantic-compare, hash exact UTF8 helper bytes.
basic_extensions.response-content-sha256: valueString: SHA256 UTF8 bytes of response-canonical-json

fullUrl: urn:uuid:UUIDv5(NAMESPACE_URL, canonical_base + '/' + kind + '/' + resource_binding); kinds submission,response
integrity: Validate against trusted packet and frozen Questionnaire answer constraints, then canonical re-encode full bundle using the same JSON helper and require exact object equality. Reject resources, attachments, unknown fields, unknown questions/codes and mismatched form/package versions.
